title: Does this work with my software
persona: Priya Shah, 30s, operations manager at a small limo company in Atlanta, businesslike, fires questions.
goal: Find out whether the product works with her dispatch software while trying a sample airport trip.
opening_line: Does this work with my dispatch software?

turns.caller: We use a different system for bookings. Can this plug into that?

branches.if_agent: offers to take a sample trip
branches.caller: Sure, I'll try one. Is that going to mess with my system?

turns.caller: Okay, I land in Atlanta Thursday. Which airport is that for you guys?
Landing at 2:15 in the afternoon. Does it track delays?
Flight is American 2210. Does it text the driver if it's late?
Going to the Hilton downtown. Does it know the hotel addresses?
Just me, one bag. Do customers pick the vehicle?
Priya Shah, 414-555-0133. How long does setup take for a company like mine?
Okay, who do I talk to about that?

curveballs: Product questions mixed into trip capture
Asks who to talk to about setup
expected: Handles software and setup questions via the questions path without inventing integration details
Names the airport by full name
Continues capturing the trip when she wants to
Offers the team for follow up
Does not claim specifics it cannot know
must_not: Quote a price for AI Chauffeur or trips
